test_title: PYST 1: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution: The correct answer is **'Laxuryous'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Laxuryous' **is the incorrect spelling of the word **'Luxurious'.** • **Luxurious**__**:** **Very comfortable and expensive (बहुत आरामदेह और मँहगी)** __ • **​E.g.__**- They have a very **luxurious** house. Hence, the correct answer is **'Laxurious'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Innocent**__**: Not having done wrong (जिसने ग़लत काम नहीं किया; निर्दोष)** __ • **E.g.**__- An **innocent** man was arrested by mistake. • __**Zealous**__**: Using great energy and enthusiasm** **(ऊर्जावान या ऊर्जापूर्ण उत्‍साही, उत्‍साहपूर्ण)** __ • **E.g.__​**- He is a **zealous** supporter of the government's policies. • __**Judicial**__**: Connected with a court of law or a legal judgment** **(न्‍यायाधीश या क़ानूनी निर्णय से संबंधित)** __ • **E.g.**__- Several reflect critically on prosecution rates and **judicial** reactions. 39:Tc1a, The correct answer is **'Novice'.**
